body: Install the localStorage/IndexedDB shim via Page.addScriptToEvaluateOnNewDocument and deliberately probe where it fails: same-origin iframe, cross-origin iframe, dedicated worker, service worker, and a page that reads localStorage before our script could run. The deliverable is the HONEST list of what leaks, not a claim that nothing does — that list becomes the per-origin coverage data the tab badge renders.
title: S4 — storage shim reach and blind spots
